richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Rajpur Sonarpur

c: Rajpur Sonarpur sits on Kolkata's southern edge, where new apartment complexes have come up alongside older neighbourhoods and ponds. Buyers here tend to have small, valuable pieces of open land: a strip beside the boundary wall, a rooftop, a corner of a school yard. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment that fits such spaces, made at our factory in Vasai, near Mumbai, about 1,650 km away.

We send the machines by road and install them through our team or a dealer in eastern India. Each station needs only a modest footprint and a firm base, and it can be grouted into concrete or set on a self-standing frame. Before anything is made, you get a layout drawing that shows exactly where each machine will go and how much room people need around it.

items.q: Can outdoor gym machines go on a society rooftop?
items.a: Often yes, if the structure can take the load and the base is suitable for fixing. Share roof details and photos with us, and check with your structural engineer before installation.

items.q: How do I fit a gym into a narrow strip of land?
items.a: Use combination machines and place them in a single row with clear space in front. Send us the length and width and we will draw a layout that fits.

items.q: Do you have dealers near Kolkata?
items.a: We have dealers in all four regions of India, including the east. Installation is done by them or by our own team.
